 The Insurance Intelligence Platform for Commercial Real Estate
Advocate Technologies is modernizing insurance operations for lenders. We transform lenders’ insurance compliance functions across origination and servicing.
We replace the manual insurance review process with a software platform supported by a highly skilled team of insurance experts. Our customers range from lenders funding small mortgages, banks funding Agency (Freddie, Fannie, HUD, SBA) loans and large commercial real estate lenders funding $100M+. If you are a lender we have a solution built just for you.
To learn more about Advocate, visit www.tryadvocate.com.
